items.title: 67251_Chuck Green oral history interview
items.q: I know he was in Mr. Arnaz' orchestra.

ctx.x: You see. But -- well, he had gotten an orchestra also -- Desi Arnaz. See? But he was still in the pit. You understand -- up here in the City of Brotherly Love. I think that was at the Earl Theater. And he had this great violinist -- Florenz something, you know. And he plays the violin like a toy -- he's so masterful. He had -- what is it -- Florenz Zebac -- Zeback or something -- he had this -- well, I seen him on the television, you know. He had pretty golden shiny or sun blond and he played violin. I haven't…
stardom was -- once you become a star, you know, you don't get no lower -- you have to get brighter. I'm quite sure this is interesting.(laughter).
